title: A CAP-like Trilemma for Large Language Models: Correctness, Non-bias, and Utility under Semantic Underdetermination

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical formalization that models bias mathematically as a hidden selection criterion or unsupported prior (value function) introduced by the model to resolve semantically underdetermined prompts.

Theoretical evaluation using hypothetical prompt examples (e.g., prioritizing corporate profit vs. employee well-being, or scholarship distribution based on merit vs. financial need) to demonstrate how decisive answers force the injection of subjective value judgments.
